run_SPMDWorker: run a Ray remote SPMDWorker actor that initializes distributed setup and executes a Runner payload
create_SPMDController: create an SPMDController to manage Ray placement groups and launch SPMDWorker actors across Slurm nodes
run_SPMDController: run the SPMDController to execute distributed worker futures across all Ray placement groups
run_ray_entrypoint: run the ray_entrypoint function to instantiate and execute a Runner from a Hydra config
run_ray_on_slurm_launch: run ray_on_slurm_launch to start a Ray cluster on Slurm with the given job config and log directory
